title: Overly permissive NSG rules audit
description: Identifies network security rules that are too broad, exposing resources to unnecessary risk.
example_prompt: "Scan all NSGs across subscriptions. Flag rules where: (1) source = 'Any' or '0.0.0.0/0' on non-load-balancer ports, (2) destination port = '*' (any), (3) priority allows wide port ranges (>100 ports). Show NSG name, rule name, direction, access, source, destination, and port range. Recommend tighter scoping."
